Commentary.Commentary: Right then. India have topped Group B. They will play the team finishing second from Group A, on Friday, November 2018 at 0000 GMT (8 pm local, previous night) while 4 hours prior, Australia will meet the number 1 team from that group. Like this group, that side too has its top 2 teams decided in England and Windies, but just the ordering needs to be done. Join us then on semi-finals' day. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Indian captain, Harmanpreet Kaur smiles. Wow. Repeat. Kaur smiles. She seems to be really happy and credits the team for stepping up against a good opposition. Agrees that the unit worked really hard on their fielding over the last 2 days and she is proud of what she saw in this game. Is happy that Mandhana played a big knock  and about the chat going on during their partnership, Harmanpreet says that she was just egging her on to keep going.

Australian skipper, Meg Lanning, says that Alyssa Healy is okay and hopes that she will be back for the semis. On the tactic about bringing spin early while bowling, Meg says that as an afterthought, it might seem as a wrong choice but at that point of time, she thought that taking pace off the ball might have been a good option, but it did not prove to be so. Admits that the loss here has shown that they have got a lot of work to do before the semi-final.

SMRITI MANDHANA HAS BEEN NAMED THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH. Says that she is quite relieved after she failed to convert her starts in the previous matches. On the review being forced by Veda Krishnamurthy after she was given out, Smriti says that whenever the ball hits her pads, she feels it is out. Credits Krishnamurthy for that as India managed to get another 20-30 runs. On comparing the wins against New Zealand and Australia, Mandhana says that both are different performances - stresses further by saying here, the bowling and fielding were excellent while against New Zealand, the batting was better.

Australia have been caught napping. They came into this tournament with high hopes and even though not everything is lost for them, plenty of chinks have been exposed in their armour by this one game. While bowling, their bowlers were forced to bowl bad lines by being put under severe pressure and during batting, they simply could not read spin. Only Ellyse Perry played an innings of some substance in an otherwise lopsided contest. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Out of 6 bowlers used, 5 were spinners. 4 of those took wickets, with combined figures of 15.4-0-80-9. Wow. Simply outstanding. The plans were pretty clear - bowl wider outside off and pack the off side, making the batters go across the line and put that extra effort.

Normally, in Guyana, it is pretty difficult to chase anything above 150 and the Indian bowling attack ensured that the stat does not change. Australia started off confidently, scoring at run-a-ball in the first 4 overs but then Villani's wicket opened the floodgates. The spinners ran riot as the Women In Yellow simply could not string partnerships.

Unbelievable, should one say? Well, to be honest, not really. Australia have got a good team but they have not played at their best in this tournament. They have a few weaknesses and all of those were exposed by India here.
OUT! Easy stumping and INDIA WIN BY 48 RUNS! Full and outside off, thrown up a bit wide, Vlaeminck comes down the track but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Bhatia does the rest.
Outside off, a cut shot missed.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Debutant Tyla Vlaeminck comes out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Caught by Bhatia. Number 8 falls. India have 5 deliveries to bowl Australia out. Not that it makes a difference but it will be a massive statement. Full and outside off, Schutt attempts a massive pull but only gets a top edge. The keeper goes across to her left and takes it.
Anuja Patil to bowl the final over.
Comes down the track and works it through mid on for one.
The quicker one outside off, punched past the bowler who parries it wide of cover. That allows the run.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Works it through the leg side for a single.
SIX! WALLOP! Floated outside off, Perry comes down the track again and this time gets some room to open up her shoulders. Swings the ball into oblivion over the mid-wicket fence.
Comes down the track and looks to flick but misses and gets a thick inside edge onto her pads.
Deepti Sharma is back on. 3-0-14-2 so far.
Works it wide of long on and gets a couple.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Megan Schutt walks in at number 9, replacing Kimmince.

OUT! That is an outstanding catch! Radha Yadav, take a bow. Full and outside off, Kimmince gets down and looks to slog but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air but not long. In fact, three fielders come in contention - the bowler, short mid-wicket and long on. The ball is in danger of landing in between but the bowler takes the call, runs back, keeps her eyes on the ball and dives forward to take the catch! Is pumped up, really! India badly want this win to finish on top. This is a big statement.
Comes down the track and eases it down to long off for a run.
Punches this through the covers and gets a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to cover.
Delissa Kimmince comes in at number 8, replacing Molineux. Radha Yadav returns as well. 3-0-8-1 so far.

OUT! Fourth catch for Veda Krishnamurthy! The ball just keeps following her. Full and around off, Molineux gets across and tries to drag it via a slog sweep over the leg side but finds Veda to perfection at long on.
Full and outside off, Sophie gets a long way across and has a heave, getting it off the inner half towards square leg.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes this to long off for a single.
Dropped short, stays low, Molineux looks to pull but misses. The ball barely bounces.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
Anuja Patil is back on. 2-0-10-0 so far.
Another long hop, pulled away for just a single this time. Another wonderful outing for Poonam - 4-0-28-2. India were 136/4 at this stage, Australia are 37 runs and a wicket behind.

IN THE AIR... FOUR! Just picked it slightly late, Arundhati Reddy. A short ball, around middle, Molineux gets across and pulls it over mid-wicket. Reddy is not sure whether to go for the catch or stay back and protect the boundary and in the end, is a touch late in going for the former. Misses it and the ball bounces in front of her and goes behind.
Dropped short again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Dropped short and outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and outside off, spooned down to long off for a single.
Who is in next? Sophie Molineux.

OUT! STUMPED! Just when a partnership was brewing, India nip it in the bud. The googly from Poonam, smartly slipped in wider outside off, Haynes does not pick it at all and blindly runs down the track. Is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and misses the line. Easy stumping for Taniya Bhatia. Quick hands.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for one. 14 from the over, India were 128/3 at this stage. Australia are 38 runs and a wicket behind.
Full and outside off, pushed through mid off for a run. 79 needed from 31 balls now. The stand moves to 30 from 25 deliveries.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Slow and short outside off, Perry goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket! Perry moves to 23 from 17 balls.
Landed outside off, Ellyse looks to steer it to third man but misses.
FOUR! VIOLENCE! Now Perry comes down the track and blasts it over Kaur down the ground! Long off dives to her right, but in vain!
FOUR! Short and outside off, Perry goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket! First boundary since the 9th over!
Short and outside off, Ellyse goes back and pulls it towards long on for one. India were 120/3 at this stage. Australia are 44 runs and a wicket behind.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
The googly, outside off, stays low, Haynes had to reach out to play that and spoons it in the air... but between cover and point. A run taken.
Short again, pulled straight to Deepti again at long on. Just a single this time. Perry moves to 10 from 11 balls.
Goes back and works it wide of long on. Should have been just a single but Deepti Sharma misfields and allows the second.
Short and outside off, Perry goes back and pulls it wide of mid-wicket for a couple.
Poonam Yadav returns. 2-0-12-1 so far.
A slower ball to end the over, Rachael looks to cut but then tries to bail out. Is beaten. India were 109/2 at this stage. Australia are 40 runs and 2 wickets behind.
Dropped short, Perry rocks back and pulls it straight to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Around off, punched back to the bowler.
Full and just outside off, Haynes steps out once more but can only get it down to long on for a run.
Comes down the track and whips it over mid-wicket for a couple.
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
The skipper brings herself on. Harmanpreet Kaur to bowl now.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single. India were 105/2 at this stage. Australia are 41 runs and 2 wickets behind.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
An appeal for a caught behind, nothing in it. A short ball, down the leg side, Haynes looks to flick but misses. No wide signalled, so must have clipped the shirt.
Short and outside off, punched through point for a single.

Fires outside off, Perry comes down the track a touch and then goes back to cut. Is beaten and the keeper whips off the bails and appeals, but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show that Ellyse had got back in.
Punched past the bowler for a run. India were 91/2 at this stage. Australia are 30 runs and 2 wickets behind.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a one.
Ellyse Perry comes in at number 6, replacing Gardner.

OUT! Number 4 goes! Australia keep sinking further into the mire. 109 more needed from 56 balls. Another googly from Poonam, Gardner comes down the track and looks to go over long off but gets more height than distance. Veda Krishnamurthy takes another catch. The wickets keep tumbling and Australia search for a set batter in the middle...
Comes down the track, takes it on the full and punches it down to long on for a run.
The googly, outside off, punched through the covers for a quick single. Gardner moves to 20 from 18 balls.
Outside off, stays low, punched straight to extra cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended. Game-changing over from Radha - just a run and a big wicket of Lanning from it.
Just flirting with the wide guideline, outside off, Haynes thinks it is a wide and let it go but it isn't.
Once again, walks a mile across and punches it through the covers for a single.
Shorter and wider outside off, could have been left alone but Gardner gets a long way across and cuts it straight to cover.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Vice-captain Rachael Haynes comes in at number 5, replacing her captain.

OUT! Caught! Meg Lanning is on her way back! Is that the game for India? Full and outside off, Meg looked to sweep it over the leg side but hit it into the wind. ASs a tesult, the ball did not have enough power and Veda Krishnamurthy took a good running catch to her right! Body blow to the Aussies. 112 more needed from 65 balls.
Once again, goes well across and cuts it in front of point for a run.
Gets well across and cuts it straight to point.
Goes wider, fuller in length, lofted down to long off for a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to cover.
SIX! Nice use of the feet. Jumps out of the crease, does Gardner, gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it high and handsome over extra cover! 50 UP FOR AUSTRALIA. 114 more needed from 70 balls.
Slowly tossed up outside off, punched straight to point.
Poonam Yadav is on as well.
One more single forced through cover.
Punches this through the covers for a run.
Another cut shot, finds point again.
Floated outside off, cut straight to point.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Radha Yadav to bowl for the first time.

NOT OUT. Missing leg. Can't say that was the worst of reviews though. Landed outside off, spinning in sharply, Lanning goes back to run it down to third man but misses. Is hit on the pads and the keeper goes up straightaway but the bowler was not that confident. Kaur though, went for the review. Hawk Eye projected it to be spinning down. A leg bye was taken.
LBW review! Is Lanning gone? Taniya Bhatia is confident that the skipper is plumb.
Full and down the leg side, swept straight to short fine leg.
Short and outside off, cut through point but this time Radha Yadav dives to her right and stops the ball.
Spins in from outside off, ML looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Lanning's territory. Short and outside off, Meg rocks back and punches it past the diving point fielder for a boundary!
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Oohhh... short and wide outside of, AG cuts it uppishly and almost finds point. Good comeback by Gardner after those 3 straight dots. 39/2 in the Powerplay for Australia, India were 46/1.

FOUR! Up and over! Fine shot. Consecutive boundaries for Gardner. Full and outside off, Ashleigh goes up and over mid off to get another boundary. 129 more needed from 85 balls now. The stand moves to 12 from 11 deliveries.

EDGED, FOUR! The pressure nearly gets a wicket. Outside off, on a length, Gardner looks to punch it on the up but gets a thick outside edge which flies past the keeper, through the vacant slip cordon, to the third man fence!
Full and outside off, driven straight to squarish short extra cover. Three dots, pressure building...
Gets away with that, short and wide outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, Gardner drives it through mid off but extra cover dives to her right and makes a half-stop.

Arundhati Reddy is back on. 1-0-11-0 so far. Meanwhile, the Australian team physio has just declared that ALYSSA HEALY WILL NOT BAT IN THIS GAME. She has a mild concussion and will be cared after. Another blow to the Aussies. Effectively 3 down then.
Down the leg side, Meg misses her clip and is hit on the pads. What an over - 4 runs and 2 wickets from it.
Clips this through mid-wicket for one.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
No hat-trick. A touch short outside off, punched through the covers for a couple through the covers.
Meg Lanning now comes out at number 4, replacing Mooney. India are on the attack, with two slips to greet the Aussie skipper.

OUT! Bowled around the legs! One wicket brings another and both the openers are back in the hut. Deepti is on a hat-trick and India are on top now. Full and down the leg side, Mooney gets low and tries to play the paddle but misses. The ball spins in and hits the leg stump! Deepti is flying now. The Indians are flying.
Ashleigh Gardner comes in at number 3, replacing Villani.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Waste of a wicket. That has come out of nowhere. A nothing ball, on a length outside off, Villani comes down the track and slogs. But straight to Veda Krishnamurthy at deep mid-wicket who comes running in and takes a decent catch. Deepti is all smiles, she knows what a big wicket that is.
FOUR! That spoils the over. Full and outside off, Mooney comes down the track and chips it over cover for a boundary!
Around off, pulled straight to square leg.
Telegraphs her intentions to play the reverse sweep and Anuja bowls a full toss outside leg. Villani goes through with the shot but can only lap it to short third man for one.
Full and outside off, bunted down to long off for a run.
Gets across, goes low and sweeps it nicely but picks out deep square leg. Just a single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, worked wide of long on for a run. The stand is now worth 20 from 18 balls.
Excellent placement. Villani goes back and works it with soft hands through mid-wicket and scurried back for the second. 149 more needed from 103 balls.
A desperate launch from Mooney, comes down the track and clubs it towards deep mid-wicket. Just a single.
SECOND WIDE OF THE OVER. Down the leg side, Beth looks to pull but misses. Excellent take from Bhatia to dive and back-flick the ball onto the stumps.
Another ridiculous LBW appeal, pitched well outside leg, hit outside leg and turned down. Flick shot missed this time.
Backs away and punches this from the stumps, straight to point.
A stifled LBW appeal, turned down. Pitched outside leg, Mooney misses her sweep and is hit on the pads.
WIDE. A loosener to start, way down the leg side, left alone. The keeper can't quite gather it and the batters think about the run but then change their mind.
Deepti Sharma has been brought on to bowl.
Excellent stop by Radha Yadav. Mooney punches this through covers but Radha dives to her left and keeps the batters to just a run.
Outside off, cut straight to backward point.
Reaches out and sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Nicely bowled, right on target, on a length, around off, watchfully defended.
Villani to face her first ball. All 7 deliveries have been faced by Mooney so far.
The arm ball to start, around middle, punched through the covers for a single.
Anuja Patil to bowl from the other end.
A full toss, on middle, clubbed away straight to deep mid-wicket for a single. 11 from the opening over.
The off-cutter, around middle, watchfully pushed back down the track.
FOUR! Poor ball. Full and down the leg side, with fine leg inside the circle. Flicked past her, to the backward square leg fence. 158 more needed from 116 balls.
FOUR! That's through! First boundary of the run chase. Full and outside off, Mooney opens the face of the bat and guides it past a diving backward point for a boundary!
On middle and leg, nicely worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and outside off pushed straight to cover.

Welcome back. A little change in the opening pair for Australia. Elyse Villani has joined Beth Mooney at the top. Alyssa Healy is being assessed after having a nasty collision with Megan Schutt earlier in the field. Arundhati Reddy to start off proceedings. Mooney to face. Here we go!
